up: Retrieve activity records for the human single-protein target CHEMBL3798. Filter for standard type 'IC50', exact standard relation '=', and non-null pChEMBL values. Return: assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows. Join activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_structures, and molecule_dictionary. Apply filters: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3798', target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606, activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type AS target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id AS tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, activities.standard_type AS standard_type, activities.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3798' AND target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606 AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id LIMIT 1000
